```{r setup, include=FALSE}
required_packages <- c(
  "ggplot2", "sf", "rnaturalearth", "rnaturalearthdata", "dplyr",
  "tidyr", "WDI", "ggrepel", "wid", "scales", "knitr"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages)
}

library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(dplyr)
library(WDI)
library(ggrepel)
library(wid)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
```

```{r country-keys}
country_key <- tibble::tribble(
  ~iso3c, ~wid_area, ~country_label, ~region,
  "AFG", "AF", "Afghanistan", "South Asia",
  "BGD", "BD", "Bangladesh", "South Asia",
  "BTN", "BT", "Bhutan", "South Asia",
  "IND", "IN", "India", "South Asia",
  "MDV", "MV", "Maldives", "South Asia",
  "NPL", "NP", "Nepal", "South Asia",
  "PAK", "PK", "Pakistan", "South Asia",
  "LKA", "LK", "Sri Lanka", "South Asia",
  "BHR", "BH", "Bahrain", "Middle East",
  "IRN", "IR", "Iran", "Middle East",
  "IRQ", "IQ", "Iraq", "Middle East",
  "ISR", "IL", "Israel", "Middle East",
  "JOR", "JO", "Jordan", "Middle East",
  "KWT", "KW", "Kuwait", "Middle East",
  "LBN", "LB", "Lebanon", "Middle East",
  "OMN", "OM", "Oman", "Middle East",
  "QAT", "QA", "Qatar", "Middle East",
  "SAU", "SA", "Saudi Arabia", "Middle East",

selected_iso3 <- country_key$iso3c

# Regional peers with both income-share and wealth-share series
chart_areas <- c("IN", "BD", "PK", "LK", "SA", "IR", "TR", "AE")
chart_key <- country_key |>
  filter(wid_area %in% chart_areas) |>
  arrange(match(wid_area, chart_areas))
```

```{r load-data}
gini_data <- WDI(
  country = "all",
  indicator = c(gini = "SI.POV.GINI"),
  start = 2000,
  end = 2025,
  extra = TRUE
)

gini_latest <- gini_data |>
  filter(iso3c %in% selected_iso3, !is.na(gini)) |>
  group_by(iso3c) |>
  slice_max(order_by = year, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(iso3c, year, gini)

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") |>
  mutate(iso3c = if_else(iso_a3 == "-99", adm0_a3, iso_a3))

regional_map <- world |>
  filter(iso3c %in% selected_iso3) |>
  left_join(gini_latest, by = "iso3c") |>
  left_join(country_key |> select(iso3c, country_label), by = "iso3c")

wid_raw <- wid::download_wid(
  indicators = c("sptinc", "shweal"),
  areas = chart_areas,
  perc = c("p0p50", "p90p100"),
  ages = 992,
  pop = "j"
)

wid_latest <- wid_raw |>
  filter(
    variable %in% c("sptinc992j", "shweal992j"),
    percentile %in% c("p0p50", "p90p100"),
    !is.na(value)
  ) |>
  distinct(country, variable, percentile, year, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  group_by(country, variable, year) |>
  filter(n_distinct(percentile) == 2) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(country, variable, percentile) |>
  slice_max(order_by = year, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(
    country_key |> select(wid_area, country_label, region),
    by = c("country" = "wid_area")
  )

make_distribution <- function(variable_code) {
  wide <- wid_latest |>
    filter(variable == variable_code) |>
    select(country, country_label, year, percentile, value) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = percentile, values_from = value) |>
    filter(!is.na(p0p50), !is.na(p90p100)) |>
    mutate(
      bottom50 = 100 * p0p50,
      top10 = 100 * p90p100,
      middle40 = 100 - bottom50 - top10
    ) |>
    arrange(top10)

  country_levels <- wide$country_label

  wide |>
    mutate(country_label = factor(country_label, levels = country_levels)) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(bottom50, middle40, top10),
      names_to = "segment",
      values_to = "share"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      segment = recode(
        segment,
        bottom50 = "Bottom 50%",
        middle40 = "Middle 40%",
        top10 = "Top 10%"
      ),
      segment = factor(
        segment,
        levels = c("Bottom 50%", "Middle 40%", "Top 10%")
      )
    )
}

plot_distribution <- function(data, title, subtitle, highlight_colors, caption) {
  highlight_points <- data |>
    filter(as.character(country_label) %in% c("India", "Saudi Arabia")) |>
    distinct(country_label) |>
    mutate(highlight = as.character(country_label))

  ggplot(data, aes(x = share, y = country_label, fill = segment, group = segment)) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE),
      width = 0.72,
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", share)),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5, reverse = TRUE),
      color = "#222222",
      size = 3,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = highlight_points,
      aes(x = -3, y = country_label, color = highlight),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      shape = 15,
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(-5, 100),
      breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
      labels = label_percent(scale = 1, accuracy = 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = 0)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Bottom 50%" = "#F6E8A8",
        "Middle 40%" = "#F2B83F",
        "Top 10%" = "#B28620"
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = highlight_colors, name = "Highlighted country") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Share of total",
      y = NULL,
      fill = "Population group",
      caption = caption
    ) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(order = 1),
      color = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(shape = 15, size = 4))
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(color = "#202833")
    )
}

income_distribution <- make_distribution("sptinc992j")
wealth_distribution <- make_distribution("shweal992j")
```

## 1. Country-level Gini coefficients

<div class="description-box">
</div>

```{r gini-map, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
label_points <- st_point_on_surface(regional_map)
label_coordinates <- st_coordinates(label_points)

country_labels <- label_points |>
  mutate(
    lon = label_coordinates[, 1],
    lat = label_coordinates[, 2],
    label = if_else(is.na(gini), "NA", sprintf("%.1f", gini))
  ) |>
  st_drop_geometry()

ggplot(regional_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = gini), color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = country_labels,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = label),
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black",
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    seed = 6843
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#2166AC", "#67A9CF", "#F7F7F7", "#EF8A62", "#B2182B"),
    name = "Gini coefficient",
    na.value = "grey80"
  ) +
  coord_sf(crs = st_crs(4326), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Income inequality in South Asia and the Middle East",
    subtitle = "Latest available country-level Gini observation, 2000–2025",
    caption = "Source: World Bank, indicator SI.POV.GINI. Grey indicates unavailable data."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )
```

plot_distribution(

  title = "Share of pre-tax national income",
  subtitle = "Bottom 50%, middle 40%, and top 10%",
  highlight_colors = c("India" = "#007F86", "Saudi Arabia" = "#D1495B"),
  caption = "Source: World Inequality Database (WID.world). Markers highlight India and Saudi Arabia."
)
